sql.user.searchUsers: select distinct upv.user_id as id, upv.first_name, upv.last_name, upv.company_id, concat(upv.first_name, ' ', upv.last_name) AS full_name, upv.email, upv.primary_flag, upv.start_date, upv.end_date, upv.position, upv.position_id, upv.user_position_id, upv.phone_number, upv.user_status_type_id, ust.user_status_type, upv.has_access, uphv.hierarchy from flow.user_positions_vw upv inner join flow.user_position_hierarchy_vw uphv on uphv.user_id = upv.user_id and uphv.position_id = upv.position_id and uphv.org_id = upv.org_id inner join flow.user_status_type ust on ust.id = upv.user_status_type_id where upv.company_id = :companyId and concat(upv.first_name, ' ', upv.last_name) ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' and upv.first_name ILIKE '%' || :firstName || '%' and upv.last_name ILIKE '%' || :lastName || '%' and coalesce(upv.email, '') ILIKE '%' || :email || '%' and coalesce(upv.phone_number, '') ILIKE '%' || :phone || '%' and upv.user_status_type_id in (:statuses) and case when :primaryFlag::boolean is not null then upv.primary_flag = :primaryFlag else 1=1 end and case when array_length(ARRAY[ :positions ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY[upv.position_id] <@ ARRAY[ :positions ]::INTEGER[] else 1=1 end and case when array_length(ARRAY[ :orgs ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY[upv.org_id] <@ ARRAY[ :orgs ]::INTEGER[] else 1=1 end union select u.id,u.first_name,u.last_name,uc.company_id, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS full_name, u.email, null,null, null,null,null, null,null,ust.id as user_status_type_id, ust.user_status_type, ust.has_access,null from flow."user" u inner join flow.user_company uc on u.id = uc.user_id inner join flow.user_status_type ust on ust.company_id = uc.company_id inner join flow.company_user_status cus on cus.user_id = u.id and cus.user_status_type_id = ust.id where uc.company_id = :companyId and not exists (select up2.id from flow.user_position up2 inner join flow.position p on p.id = up2.position_id where up2.user_id = u.id and p.company_id = uc.company_id) and concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' and u.first_name ILIKE '%' || :firstName || '%' and u.last_name ILIKE '%' || :lastName || '%' and coalesce(u.email, '') ILIKE '%' || :email || '%' and case when array_length(ARRAY[ :positions ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then false else 1=1 end and case when array_length(ARRAY[ :orgs ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then false else 1=1 end and coalesce(u.phone_number, '') ILIKE '%' || :phone || '%' and cus.user_status_type_id in (:statuses) order by last_name, first_name, start_date desc limit :limit offset :offset;
sql.user.searchUserCount: with t1 as ( select distinct upv.user_id as id from flow.user_positions_vw upv inner join flow.user_position_hierarchy_vw uphv on uphv.user_id = upv.user_id and uphv.position_id = upv.position_id and uphv.org_id = upv.org_id inner join flow.user_status_type ust on ust.id = upv.user_status_type_id where upv.company_id = :companyId and upv.position_level = 0 and concat(upv.first_name, ' ', upv.last_name) ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' and upv.first_name ILIKE '%' || :firstName || '%' and upv.last_name ILIKE '%' || :lastName || '%' and coalesce(upv.email, '') ILIKE '%' || :email || '%' and coalesce(upv.phone_number, '') ILIKE '%' || :phone || '%' and upv.user_status_type_id in (:statuses) and case when :primaryFlag::boolean is not null then upv.primary_flag = :primaryFlag else 1=1 end and case when array_length(ARRAY[ :positions ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY[upv.position_id] <@ ARRAY[ :positions ]::INTEGER[] else 1=1 end and case when array_length(ARRAY[ :orgs ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY[upv.org_id] <@ ARRAY[ :orgs ]::INTEGER[] else 1=1 end union select u.id from flow."user" u inner join flow.user_company uc on u.id = uc.user_id inner join flow.user_status_type ust on ust.company_id = uc.company_id inner join flow.company_user_status cus on cus.user_id = u.id and cus.user_status_type_id = ust.id where uc.company_id = :companyId and not exists (select up2.id from flow.user_position up2 inner join flow.position p on p.id = up2.position_id where up2.user_id = u.id and p.company_id = uc.company_id) and concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' and u.first_name ILIKE '%' || :firstName || '%' and u.last_name ILIKE '%' || :lastName || '%' and coalesce(u.email, '') ILIKE '%' || :email || '%' and case when array_length(ARRAY[ :positions ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then false else 1=1 end and case when array_length(ARRAY[ :orgs ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then false else 1=1 end and coalesce(u.phone_number, '') ILIKE '%' || :phone || '%' and ust.id in (:statuses) ) select count(*) from t1
sql.user.exportUsers: select u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS full_name, u.email, u.phone_number, ust.id as user_status_type_id, ust.user_status_type, p.position from flow.user u inner join flow.user_company uc on uc.user_id = u.id inner join flow.user_status_type ust on ust.company_id = uc.company_id inner join flow.company_user_status cus on cus.user_id = u.id and cus.user_status_type_id = ust.id left join flow.user_position up on up.user_id = u.id left join flow.position p on p.id = up.position_id where uc.company_id = :companyId and concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' and u.first_name ILIKE '%' || :firstName || '%' and u.last_name ILIKE '%' || :lastName || '%' and u.email ILIKE '%' || :email || '%' and u.phone_number ILIKE '%' || :phone || '%' and ust.id in (:statuses) and case when array_length(ARRAY[ :positions ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY[p.id] <@ ARRAY[ :positions ]::INTEGER[] else 1=1 end order by u.last_name, u.first_name, up.start_date desc
sql.user.updateUser: update flow."user" set first_name = :firstName, last_name = :lastName, email = :email, phone_number = :phone, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.user.insertUser: insert into flow.user(first_name, last_name, created_by_id, phone_number, email, username, password) values(:firstName, :lastName, :createdById, :phone, :email, :email, :defaultPassword);
sql.user.getOne: select u.id, u.phone_number, u.email, u.created_by_id, u.first_name, u.last_name, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS full_name, uc.company_id, u.modified_by_id, u.date_modified, u.default_company_id, ust.user_status_type, ust.id as user_status_type_id, ust.has_access, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(companies))) FROM ( select c.id, c.company_name as "companyName", c.parent_company_id as "parentCompanyId", c.aws_bucket as "awsBucket", c.abbreviation from flow.user_company uc inner join flow.company c on c.id = uc.company_id where uc.user_id = u.id and uc.archived is not true order by c.company_name ) companies), '[]') as companies from flow."user" u inner join flow.user_company uc on uc.user_id = u.id inner join flow.company_user_status cus on cus.user_id = u.id inner join flow.user_status_type ust on ust.company_id = uc.company_id and ust.id = cus.user_status_type_id where u.id = :id and uc.company_id = :companyId and uc.archived is not true
sql.user.getSchedulingUsers:
with t1 as ( select distinct upv.user_id as id, upv.first_name, upv.last_name, concat(upv.first_name, ' ', upv.last_name) AS full_name, concat(upv.first_name, ' ', upv.last_name) AS title
from flow.user_positions_vw upv where upv.position_schedulable is true and case when :isParent and :isSchedulingTool then array [upv.company_id] <@ (select array(select id from flow.company_hierarchy_filter_down(:parentCompanyId::int))) else (upv.company_id = :companyId OR (:isSchedulingTool AND upv.company_id = :parentCompanyId AND upv.available_to_children is true)) end and case when :stateId::integer is not null then upv.state_id = :stateId::integer and upv.position_schedulable is true else upv.position_schedulable is true end and upv.user_archived is not true and upv.start_date <= now() and upv.has_access is true and (upv.end_date is null or upv.end_date >= now()) ) select id, first_name, last_name, full_name, title, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(positions))) FROM ( SELECT up.id, up.user_id as "userId", p.position, up.position_id as "positionId", up.org_id as "orgId", o.state_id as "stateId", up.start_date as "startDate", up.end_date as "endDate", up.primary_flag as "primaryFlag", up.archived, (select json_agg(json_build_object( 'orgId', h.org_id, 'orgName', h.org_name, 'positionLevel', h.position_level, 'orgLevelId', h.org_level_id ) order by h.org_level_id)::jsonb from flow.user_org_hierarchy(up.org_id) as h) as "hierarchy" FROM flow.user_position up inner join flow.position p on p.id = up.position_id inner join flow.org o on o.id = up.org_id WHERE up.user_id = t1.id and up.archived is not true and (up.end_date is null or up.end_date >= now())) positions), '[]') AS "userPositions" from t1 order by full_name
sql.user.findByUsernameIgnoreCase: select u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.password, u.email, u.username, (select has_access from flow.company_user_status cus inner join flow.user_status_type ust on ust.id = cus.user_status_type_id where user_id = u.id and ust.company_id = uc.company_id ) as has_access, coalesce(u.default_company_id, uc.company_id) as company_id, ( select parent_company_id from flow.company c where c.id = coalesce(u.default_company_id, uc.company_id) ) as parent_company_id, ( select case when parent_company_id is null or parent_company_id = 1 then coalesce(u.default_company_id, uc.company_id) else parent_company_id end from flow.company c where c.id = coalesce(u.default_company_id, uc.company_id) ) as highest_parent_company_id, null as "timezone", concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS full_name, ( select c.id from flow.company c inner join flow.user_company uc on uc.company_id = c.id where uc.user_id = u.id and uc.archived is not true order by level limit 1 ) as highest_company_id, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(positions))) FROM ( SELECT up.id, up.user_id as "userId", p.position, up.position_id as "positionId", up.org_id as "orgId", o.org_name as "orgName", up.start_date as "startDate", up.end_date as "endDate", up.primary_flag as "primaryFlag", up.archived, (select json_agg(json_build_object( 'orgId', h.org_id, 'orgName', h.org_name, 'positionLevel', h.position_level, 'orgLevelId', h.org_level_id ) order by h.org_level_id)::jsonb from flow.user_org_hierarchy(up.org_id) as h) as "hierarchy" FROM flow.user_position up inner join flow.position p on p.id = up.position_id inner join flow.org o on o.id = up.org_id WHERE up.user_id = u.id and up.archived is not true and (up.end_date is null or up.end_date >= now())) positions), '[]') AS "userPositions" from flow.user u inner join flow.user_company uc on uc.user_id = u.id where case when :username::text is not null then lower(username) = lower(:username::text) else u.id = :userId::integer end and uc.is_default = true limit 1
sql.user.findByUsernameOrEmailIgnoreCase: select u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.password, u.email, u.username, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS full_name from flow.user u where lower(:usernameOrEmail::text) = lower(username) OR lower(:usernameOrEmail::text) = lower(email) limit 1
sql.user.findUserById: select u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS full_name, u.password, coalesce(u.default_company_id, uc.company_id) as company_id, c.aws_bucket, (select has_access from flow.company_user_status cus inner join flow.user_status_type ust on ust.id = cus.user_status_type_id where user_id = u.id and ust.company_id = uc.company_id ) as has_access, ( select parent_company_id from flow.company c where c.id = coalesce(u.default_company_id, uc.company_id) ) as parent_company_id, ( select case when parent_company_id is null or parent_company_id = 1 then coalesce(u.default_company_id, uc.company_id) else parent_company_id end from flow.company c where c.id = coalesce(u.default_company_id, uc.company_id) ) as highest_parent_company_id, ( select c.id from flow.company c inner join flow.user_company uc on uc.company_id = c.id where uc.user_id = u.id and uc.archived is not true order by level limit 1 ) as highest_company_id from flow.user u inner join flow.user_company uc on uc.user_id = u.id inner join flow.company c on c.id = uc.company_id where u.id = :id and uc.is_default is true
sql.user.getCompanyUserStatuses: select id, user_status_type, company_id, has_access, archived from flow.user_status_type where company_id = :companyId and archived is not true order by user_status_type
sql.user.updateUserStatus: update flow.company_user_status cus set user_status_type_id = :userStatusTypeId, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUserId from flow.user_status_type ust where ust.id = cus.user_status_type_id and cus.user_id = :userId and ust.company_id = :companyId
sql.user.insertUserStatus: insert into flow.company_user_status(user_id, user_status_type_id, created_by_id) values (:userId, :userStatusTypeId, :currentUserId)
sql.user.updateDefault: update flow.user_company set is_default = false where user_id = :userId; update flow.user_company set is_default = true where company_id = :companyId and user_id = :userId;
sql.user.updateAdminDefault: update flow.user set default_company_id = :companyId where id = :userId
sql.user.insertUserCompany: insert into flow.user_company(company_id, user_id, is_default) values (:companyId, :id, :isDefault)
sql.user.archiveUserCompanies: update flow.user_company set archived = true where user_id = :userId and company_id not in (:companyIds)
sql.user.upsertUserCompany: insert into flow.user_company(company_id, user_id) values (:companyId, :userId) ON CONFLICT (company_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET archived = false;
sql.user.checkEmailExists: select id, email from flow."user" where email ILIKE :email and case when :userId::int is not null then :userId::int != id else 1=1 end
sql.user.saveForgotPasswordFields: update flow."user" set uuid = :uuid, expiry_date = :expiryDate where id = :id
sql.user.saveUserPassword: update flow."user" set password = :password where id = :id
sql.user.findByUserUuid: select u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.password, u.email, u.username, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS full_name, u.uuid, u.expiry_date from flow.user u where u.uuid = :uuid limit 1
